name: Mercury402
tagline: Treasury/FRED financial data over x402: 78 pay-per-call US endpoints, free to browse and quote
description:
Mercury402 serves Treasury/FRED financial data over x402: 78 pay-per-call US financial data endpoints covering Treasury yields and auctions, 53 FRED endpoints, forex, yield spreads, breakeven inflation, macro composites and AI briefings. Each call is priced per request ($0.05 to $0.50) and paid in USDC on Base. No API key, no subscription.

Tools: `list_endpoints` (browse all 78 endpoints with prices and parameters, read-only) and `get_endpoint_data` (call an endpoint and return the data, or the HTTP 402 quote and payment instructions).

Free by default: without a wallet the server only lists endpoints and returns quotes. Paid mode is opt-in and capped per call. Not affiliated with mercury-x402-mcp (io.github.mercuryx402).

env.name: MERCURY402_PAYER_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Optional. Private key of a dedicated low-balance USDC-on-Base wallet for paid mode. Without it the server only lists endpoints and returns 402 quotes. Stored in plaintext in the client config: never use a main wallet.

env.name: MERCURY402_MAX_PRICE_USD
env.description: Optional per-call spending cap in USD for paid mode (default 0.50).

install.notes: Free by default: discovery plus 402 quotes, no wallet needed. Hosted alternative with nothing to install: https://mcp.mercury402.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no auth, discovery-only, never pays).
